roster.name: Sky Foundry
roster.description: Airborne-only invincible command grab; existing approved lift and slam.

roster.name: Iron Dominion
roster.description: Upper-body armored advance. +14 on first-active block, close hard knockdown on hit. Lows and throws bypass armor.

roster.name: Freemason
roster.description: Heavy damage and wall carry. The committed horizontal hammer finisher.

roster.name: Grand Design
roster.description: Delayed moving stone wave. Return control after the cast; a hit launches for a follow-up. Does not refresh Drive.

roster.name: Flashpoint
roster.description: Invincible short-range backhand flame strike. Punishable on block.

roster.name: The Air Is Mine
roster.description: Stationary gas field, three blockable pulses. Hold back/neutral/forward during the cast for near/middle/far placement. Disappears if Smoke is hit.

roster.name: Last Orders
roster.description: Regular-stance invincible uppercut into headbutt. Hit enters Dempsey stance.

roster.name: Whiskey Chaser
roster.description: Dempsey-only hook barrage. Plus on block; hit finishes in stance. No invulnerability.

roster.name: No Safe Harbour
roster.description: Long narrow hook thrust, reel and corner carry. Jumping over the horizontal lane beats it.

roster.name: Undertow
roster.description: Invincible close hook sweep. Confirmed hit switches sides and restores spear spacing.

roster.name: Bloodletting
roster.description: Advancing crosscut. Confirmed hit applies or refreshes owned bleed and hard knockdown.

roster.name: Exsanguinate
roster.description: Close crossing-knife finish. Consumes owned bleed and pays at most 150 stored grey life once, in addition to scaled base damage.
